The original copyright and license notices remain in the bundled file.
Our independently written extension code is separate from this component.

`mediabunny-1.66.0.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs`
from the official npm package `mediabunny@1.66.0`.
It is bundled locally and performs no remote script loading. No desktop executable
or encoder is required by this extension's encoded AVC/AAC remux path.

Original project and corresponding source:
https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.66.0.tgz

The npm archive includes the corresponding TypeScript source in `package/src/`.
Download and extract that exact archive to obtain source under MPL-2.0. No
Mediabunny source has been modified here.

SHA-256 archive: 9c93b1a9a7e08dc78fa975f6d91256beaa62942bd949f1673a8b9b5539bf0c17
SHA-256 bundled module: c26f218c23c3d2e97574c9399a75dccb91ceddcac3a6fd4593e9a390320b494a

Reproduce: `npm pack mediabunny@1.66.0`, verify the archive hash above, extract,
and copy `package/dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` and `package/LICENSE` here.
